integer.floorNode: floor_div(n,d) is the sole division form and elaborates to one FloorDiv node; floor(action,local) occurs only in a policy and must name the unique local whose value expression root is that FloorDiv node

types.amountCoreRepresentation: closed {value:UInt128Text,unit:Identifier} on every AST, manifest, input, state, effect, obligation, and result wire object
types.numericLookingText: text("123") remains Text; contents never infer UInt128

quantityClassification.anyOtherVector: expression-only Quantity; may be let-bound, but cannot be persistent state, action/observation/constant data, a set result, or an emit operand

units.unitVectorWire: ordered array of closed {unit:Identifier,exponent:SignedExponentText}; omit zero exponents; order by unit ASCII; empty array is UInt128
units.signedExponentText: canonical decimal text: 0 or -?[1-9][0-9]*, range -16..16; plus sign and -0 forbidden
units.settlementOrientation: quantum.value nominal subunits per one ledger base unit; require value mod quantum.value = 0 and ledgerAmount=value/quantum.value with UInt128 checks
units.unitErasure: only Transfer, Fee, and DueSettled after exact unique asset/unit binding and quantum conversion

fieldPolicyCoverage: every Amount-valued set target and every Amount-valued effect field occurrence has exactly one explicit policy target; targets are disjoint and exhaustive

genesisVersusDynamic.declaredDynamicValues: state field values change by set during evaluation
genesisVersusDynamic.checkedGenesisMetadata: profile, lifetime, horizon, units, consts, schemas, field policies, settlement bindings, action bodies, and initial literals are authenticated at genesis and are not rewritten by evaluate

swapOutput.scope: fixed-vector one-transition fixture; expected_output prevents reuse for a second input
